title: Quincy's Plate
description: Fancy plates that can hold miscellaneous items.
body:
Now adds plates that may hold multiple items to the game. Finely compatible with Jade.
![All the plates by version 1.0.3](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/240f8786355cc97a036837db6dc1939d410a191a.png)
![Food in Plates](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/c12db958f33a5be6a008d78e21e5b0a1c9f3e6e5.png)
They may also stack on top of each other, so you can design your own dishes as you like.
![Design your own dish as you like](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/9390a2bb8ab65efe1b73a2a75837c687e488b70b.png)
If you like it's fine to make a bread tower for your friend(though it's a little bit fps-costly)...
![Bread Tower made of 212 breads](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/118117f2c0dfbe83531592b0d333f42aedf3e133.png)
From mod version V0.2, square plates are added as well. Besides, you can also right click plates with a fork to directly eat the food you point to. Compatible with mods like Spice of Life: Carrot Edition.
![Square plates and fork](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/071c445e6b88be2747b171da2c871202cb808a9c.png)

Due to my poor art abilities, there were only pure color plates at the beginning. Thanks to your contribution, textured plates have been added since mod version V0.3. I tried to draw some variants with textures but it turned out to be beyond me. Sorry for that :(

I'm new to Minecraft modding and this is my first published work. It may be buggy and any bug feedback will be appreciated.

Best gratitude to:

Zeno2333, a friend who offered some ingenious advice to me.  
CharacterXK, who contributed some wonderful models and textures.

Have fun :)
